text_block_list.text:
After school training came to an end,
I spotted Mejiro Ryan by the water fountain.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Phaaah! That feels amazing~!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha! I poured water right over my head, Trainer!
Doing this after a hard workout is the absolute best!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Why don't you try it too, Trainer?
choice_data_list: Hmm... Think I'll pass on that.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Aw, bummer.
It tightens up your traps and gives you such an invigorating rush, too.

As she laughed, I noticed something about her eyes—
her eyelashes seemed a little moist...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...!
Whoa-whoa-whoa!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
N-No way! Why would I be?!
I wasn't crying or anything...

Despite her words, her eyes began to glisten with tears...
I decided to wait patiently until she calmed down.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...*sigh*.
Well, that didn't stay hidden for long, did it?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: To be honest... I've been on a losing streak against McQueen in our mock races lately.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
No matter how much I run, I just can't catch up to her.
And it's... I don't know, it's just...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's so, soooo frustrating...
Aiming to win... really isn't easy after all.
Looking closely at Mejiro Ryan, she appeared noticeably thinner than before.
Has she been pushing herself too hard during her personal workouts...?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? Food...
Um... I think I had breakfast this morning... maybe...

Hearing that, I was stunned.
Right now, what I needed to do as her Trainer was clear---

The cafeteria was quiet and empty in the late afternoon.
Mejiro Ryan looked around restlessly, feeling out of place.
Just then, the mega-sized katsu curry I ordered arrived at the table.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Hyah! Trainer!
Wh-What on earth is this...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
B-But...!
Snacking at this hour isn't what an athlete should be doing...
choice_data_list: Don't worry about that, just eat up for today.
It's fine, don't hold back just for today.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Still...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
...All right. If you say so, Trainer.
It really does... smell delicious.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Down the hatch!
With that, Mejiro Ryan devoured the entire plate of curry in no time flat!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
It's seriously so good...
I can feel the protein surging straight into all my muscles...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: Trainer...

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
Come to think of it, I've been so fixated on racing lately...
I never made time to sit down and enjoy a proper meal like this.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text:
I'm so hopeless.
Whenever I get anxious, I lose sight of the important things.

Whenever she loses a race, she panics and gets tunnel vision,
often preventing her from displaying her true potential.
If she can broaden her perspective, there are bound to be so many possibilities waiting for Mejiro Ryan.
choice_data_list: Let's discover your true potential together.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Ryan
text_block_list.text: My potential, huh...
Mejiro Ryan watched the horsegirls passing by outside the window, seemingly lost in deep thought.
